title: Chapter 249 Penetrating Influence
content:
Chapter 249 Penetrating Influence

That's right, in today's world, the situation is exactly as Zhong Yu said.

The Qin State has been defeated, the Central Plains countries are about to face the conflict of interests of the other side, and the Qi State in the east will also face the crusade of other countries, and the whole world can be said to be completely chaotic.

Under such circumstances, it is also Yuguo, because living alone in the northern border and away from the Central Plains, he can recuperate, accumulate strength, and wait and see the great changes in the Central Plains.

And after more than two years, Yuguo is not as mysterious as before.

Regardless of whether it is big or small, south or north, or forces that have just been born or are about to perish, countless secret agents have been sent to the mysterious north, spying on news one after another.

Although many people fell on the way, the results one after another continued to spread to all parts of the Central Plains, which aroused the amazement of many forces.

The news released by the Yu Kingdom before was actually not a bragging. The territory is thousands of miles, more than twice that of the Chu Kingdom. There are millions of people, second only to Qin, and the young and strong population is more than one million.

Such a powerful force, even if it has just annexed the Donghu people and Jizi North Korea, and some other large or small aboriginals, it swelled up.

But it should not be underestimated by the people of the world, and it has aroused their deep fear and panic. They know that as long as the Yu Kingdom is given a period of time to allow them to initially digest the population and territory, then they will become a country bigger than the Qin Kingdom. There is also a terrifying opponent, a behemoth that hangs over the heads of the countries.

After all, Qin State is next to the other countries and has long been in contact with other countries in the world. It is the traditional area of Chinese civilization, and the motherland knows a lot about him. But Yuguo is located on the vast grassland, located in the northern border, covered by ice and snow, the Central Plains knows nothing about him.

If the countries want to attack Yuguo, among other things, the problem of the route alone can drag down more than half of their army.

And the millions of young and strong men in Yuguo are also a great deterrent to the nations. Not to mention, the Xiongnu and the two alien races in the north who had already surrendered to foreign countries.

These three forces, after more than two years of suppression and training, have long been led by Yu Guo's orders, and Yu Guo can draw nearly 300,000 cavalry from them at any time, and their strength is terrifying.

It is precisely because of such a powerful strength, even if it does not explode, it is enough to make the countries fearful.

That's why all countries in the world, countries that are interested in fighting against Qin, will regard Yuguo as the leader of the alliance, and dare not have the slightest disagreement, and will be convinced.

Now, according to what King Jing said before him, after the defeat of Qin, the world will not be peaceful, but will fall into a greater turmoil.

How many of them will die as a result? It is hard to predict how many powerful families will be destroyed because of this, and the hundreds of schools will be weakened or even cut off.

Out of this consideration, the three of Xiaoyaozi couldn't help but fell into deep thought.

Among them, Master Ban was the most shaken.

This cannot be blamed on him, after all, the Mo family where Master Bang is located is located in the country of Yan, and the country of Yan is located in the northern border, next to the country of Yu. Not to mention that the Yan Kingdom was defeated by the Yu Kingdom just a few years ago, embezzling half of the population and territory, and now the country is in decline.

And in the past two years, relying on the name of being the head of the alliance, Yu Guo has continuously exerted influence on the Yan State, permeating the courts and localities of the Yan State, and his control over the Yan State has long been deeply rooted and difficult to shake.

Other countries may not be very clear about the current situation of Yan State's court, but as the only university school in Yan State, the Mohists, who have a deeper understanding of Yan State, are very clear.

He knew very well that in the court of Yan Kingdom, many ministers had secretly defected to Yu Kingdom, and many of the army had been infiltrated.

Among other things, Yan Yi, the great general who was just made king a few days ago, and the big hammer of ten thousand generals are living examples.

After all, the two of them accepted the reward from Yu Kingdom. That is to say, from the moment they accepted, the two of them broke away from the Yan Kingdom, and instead became a subsidiary state of the Yu Kingdom, that is, the courtiers of the Yu Kingdom.

As one of the few generals in the Yan Kingdom, and one of them was the general who commanded all the troops of the Yan Kingdom, they all made this kind of behavior that was close to betrayal, and you can see how deep the penetration of the Yu Kingdom is.

Therefore, Master Ban, and all the leaders of the Mohists, believed that the current Yan Kingdom is not so much an independent kingdom, but a puppet supported by the Yu Kingdom, almost a vassal state.

Looking at the current Yan State, there is almost no possibility of refusing the order of the Yu State, sending troops to resist the Qin State, and transporting food and grass to support the front line. With all these things, Yu Guo has directly intervened in the state affairs of Yan State.

As the Mohist family is a big force located in the country of Yan, nearly half of the disciples of the Mohist family are from the country of Yan, and the headquarters of the Mohist family is also located in the country of Yan. With all kinds of restraints and considerations about the future of the Mohist School, Master Ban naturally had to be cautious.

After all, since the death of the giant Liuzhi Heixia three years ago, the Mo family has been caught in a slight civil strife. Many senior elders, as well as new cutting-edge factions, began to fight for power.

Up to now, although Master Ban has relied on the support of the two leaders Robo Zhi and Jing Ke, as well as the followers attracted by his own superb and top-notch Mohism mechanism technique, he has barely suppressed all the opposition in the entire school. On the surface, it unified the entire Mohism.

But it is undeniable that after this long period of internal friction, the strength of the Mohist school has lost a full 20-30%, and the current Mohistry is not in harmony with the face and heart, and the power of the entire school cannot be truly integrated into one place and effectively used stand up.

The power that can really obey the command of the class master and use it in external struggles is less than half of what it was before the death of the six-fingered black man.

Such a decline has almost reached the lowest point in the history of the Mohist school. Even so, the Mohist school is still the top school in the Jianghu. .

But his strength is also very reluctant, the first-class masters that can be found in the entire school, but three or four, can only be compared with the small school of famous masters.

The current momentum and reputation of the Mohist School are only supported by his superb Mohist mechanism skills and a large number of disciples.

Out of this consideration, Master Ban hesitated in his heart, and finally made up his mind to completely surrender to Yuguo.

After all, the Mohists are already in the radiating range of Yuguo's influence. If they really reject this kind of solicitation, it might bring a fatal blow to Yuguo.

Today's Mohists can't resist the edge of Yuguo, which can almost be called the most powerful country in the world.
